Character: the flame-shaped figure is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (the turnaround sheet shows his shape from every side; the expression sheet shows every eye shape he makes). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. At rest his face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it: nothing is drawn above his eyes and nothing below them. At the upper left of the wall is one white-framed window glowing with warm sunlight, cut off by the top of the frame. On the desk, in the middle of the frame, stands one teal desk lamp with a yellow shade turned toward the left. Warm morning sunlight with soft cool shadows, so the room has depth and glow. On the right half of the desk stands a pile of things, exactly where the source video shows each one, and none of them ever changes: one thick stack of white worksheets with one blank yellow sticky note on its front; on top of the stack one black-and-white soccer ball; behind the ball one blank cream sheet of paper standing upright and leaning back; to the right of the stack one blank white poster board standing on its edge against the wall, with one blank pale-blue sticky note near its top; and in front of the poster board one blank white calendar page with a red band across its top, leaning back against the poster board. At the front corners of the desk lie two crumpled balls of paper and two marker pens. One more blank white sheet of paper lies on top of the soccer ball and stays there. LETTERING RULE: every sheet of paper, sticky note, card, page, board and box in this shot is BLANK. Paint no letters, no numbers, no words, no symbols, no music notes and no handwriting anywhere in the frame. Where the source video shows the top of Sol's flame tinted deep indigo-violet, fading down into his normal orange, paint exactly that tint and exactly as much of it as each source frame shows. The few thin short navy vertical lines high on the left side of his face belong to that look: copy them only in the frames where the source shows them.

For the whole shot, from the first frame to the last, the top of his flame is deep indigo-violet fading down to orange, with thin short lines high on the left side of his face. 2. He leans forward toward the camera. 3. At 2.45 seconds he dips and hunches with both arm nubs raised, and his eyes become two sideways chevrons with rounded tips, pointing at each other like > <. They stay that way to the last frame.
